headline: Commission approves certificate of compliance, closes five hearings, issues six Orders of Conditions, and continues a deck proposal
summary: The Commission reviewed several wetland permit applications, closed public hearings on five continued Notices of Intent, and issued Orders of Conditions with special conditions for those projects. It also acted on Requests for Determination of Applicability for fence, staircase, and tree removal projects, amended an enforcement order at 181 Elliott Street, and continued a deck proposal at 228 Common Lane to the June 9, 2026 meeting.
decisions: Issued a Complete Certificate of Compliance for 55 Abbott Street, DEP File #5-1008, including perpetual conditions #40-43, 5-0.
Closed the hearing for 206 Greenwood Avenue, DEP File #5-1469, 5-0.
Closed the hearing for 55 Abbott Street, DEP File #5-1468, 5-0.
Closed the hearing for 212 Common Lane, DEP File #5-1467, 5-0.
Closed the hearing for 7 Hathaway Avenue, DEP File #5-1466, 5-0.
Closed the hearing for 5 Orchard Street, DEP File #5-1470, 5-0.
Closed the hearing for 13 Butterworth Road, DEP File #5-1465, 5-0.
Failed a motion to issue a Negative 3 Determination for 228 Common Lane deck and stairs project, 2-3.
Continued the 228 Common Lane Request for Determination to the June 9, 2026 meeting, 5-0.
Issued a Negative 3 Determination of Applicability with conditions for 11 Meadow Road fence replacement, 5-0.
Issued a Negative 3 Determination of Applicability with conditions for 23 Virginia Avenue staircase addition, 5-0.
Issued a Negative 3 Determination of Applicability with conditions for 21 Temi Road tree removal, 5-0.
Amended the Enforcement Order for 181 Elliott Street to require a final restoration plan by June 2, 2026, to be presented at the June 9, 2026 meeting, 4-0.
Approved Conservation Agent April mileage of $32.63 and $29.48, 4-0.
Issued an Order of Conditions for 206 Greenwood Avenue, DEP File #5-1469, with special conditions, 4-0.
Issued an Order of Conditions for 55 Abbott Street, DEP File #5-1468, with special conditions, 4-0.
Issued an Order of Conditions for 212 Common Lane, DEP File #5-1467, with special conditions, 4-0.
Issued an Order of Conditions for 7 Hathaway Avenue, DEP File #5-1466, with special conditions, 4-0.
Issued an Order of Conditions for 5 Orchard Street, DEP File #5-1470, with special conditions, 4-0.
Issued an Order of Conditions for 13 Butterworth Road, DEP File #5-1465, with special conditions, 4-0.
Approved the meeting minutes of April 29, 2026, as submitted, 4-0.
